## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass (and, for `web/` changes, `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`)

- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed, and nothing documented that does not exist
- [ ] No new network calls, telemetry, or secrets in logs; security impact considered
- [ ] Commits follow conventional commits
